Verschlüsselt die Verbindung zum Panel,: Encrypts the connection to the panel so passwords cannot be read along the way. HTTP and HTTPS run on the same port; with HTTPS on, http:// is redirected automatically.
Vor jedem Speichern hebt das Panel die K: Before every save the panel keeps the configuration files, the last five versions. Restoring overwrites the current files; that can be undone as well.

Zeigt auf einer Karte, aus welchen Lände: Shows on a map which countries and cities players connect from. Only country and city are stored, never IP addresses.
